notes.content: Independent reader R2, GPT-6 Astra Pro, inherited effort (not exposed), run scan036-R2-2026-11-19. Only the assigned page images, page-only C/H inputs, doubts, metadata, brief, preamble and empty notation snapshot were consulted. No other reader, page, OCR, web source or PDF text layer was consulted.

The upper part finishes an angular argument: an exterior angle greater than π supplies an interior angle below π, and the page invokes three vertices of a convex polygon to conclude the preceding lemma. It then states Lemme XI about a pair of vertices visible from the interior and begins a proof using a triangle with neighboring vertices. The proof treats an empty-intersection case and then a containment case involving the opposite open edge.

notes.content: The uses after = in intersection formulas and after ≠ in the final line suggest that the crossed loop denotes the empty set. This contextual observation was not allowed to override its nearly vertical phi-like stroke. Reading phi leads, with varnothing retained as an alternative.

Containment of an intersection in an open edge does not by itself establish that the intersection is nonempty: the empty set also satisfies the containment. This narrow logical check is consistent with the written non vide? question. It does not decide the meaning of the detached diagonal mark; that mark is transcribed from its visible geometry.

No preceding lemma, definition of visibility, or surrounding page was available or consulted. The n=3 objection, correction to lemme X, and instruction to use the demonstration of VIII are recorded as manuscript claims. The whole lemma has not been independently proved or refuted.

Retained def., interieur, determiné, inferieur, colineaires, exterieur, mésure, ennoncée, and et et. The apparent possible acute on the second-paragraph interieur was resolved by crop 12 as an i dot, not an e accent.

Manuscript page IX is at upper right, with top and bottom rules. The named result is Lemme XI. Archive pencil sheet number 35 appears at lower left and is a comment only. No date or total page count is visible.

The main body is fair-copy ink. Several thicker annotations are inventoried as another unnamed hand (main ink); pale notes and circles are inventoried as another unnamed hand (pencil). This is a material/appearance distinction, not a named-author attribution. The side-count sign is heavily darkened within otherwise pale annotation, so its precise writing medium remains less secure.

hua_has=text. H has an editorial main-text summary plus transcribed marginal notes; it has no complete diplomatic main text for this page. Main omissions are reported by seven coherent blocks. No summary paraphrase was treated as literal ink. Annotation disagreements and omissions are separately itemized.

No geometric triangle drawing or commutative diagram is present. The graphic annotations are the two ovals, connecting pencil leaders, insertion leaders, underlining, cancellations and a detached diagonal with lower barb. These are preserved using the supplied macros and standard TikZ.
